_about: Field-emission policy for mbxmoods.json, read by BOTH the truedat scan writer and --fixup so scan-time emission and existing-catalog cleanup use one source of truth. Any field NOT listed here is Extended (emitted, pass-through). Only required + excluded + summarize need enumerating. Scope = 'what we have': only fields the current no-profile extractor computes. Reinstating a suppressed/dropped field costs a FULL library re-scan (raw extractor JSON is deleted at parse).
_sidecarHotSet: Fields the .mbxs sidecar carries for MBXHub's boot + per-pick HOT path (a projection of the hot subset of required; cold required fields lazy-load from JSON). Two lifecycles: (1) CORE identity+gate block = path (the key) + audioStreamSha256 (content identity / _moodByHash index) + genre + speechLikely (playability gate) -- 'who is this and can we play it', PERMANENT + model-independent, never dropped; (2) MODEL-INPUT block = the 24 V/A model inputs, the only part an input-SET change bumps. Separating them means a model retrain/reorder touches only the model block and can never silently drop identity/gate (the 2026-08-12 v3 gap: audioStreamSha256 + speechLikely are hot-required but the record projected model inputs only). Physical record layout: CatalogSidecar.cs.

dispositions.required: a consumer depends on it (pick blend / V-A model / identity / exclude gate / truedat write-time verdict / re-extract canary). Always emitted; never stripped; missing => warning.
dispositions.summarize: drop the raw heavy array, keep write-time derived scalars. Currently unused.
dispositions.excluded: not emitted on scan; stripped by --fixup if found.

_added_by_sanity_check_2026_08_10.fingerprint: fingerprint.v1 — hi-res + lossy-transcode verdicts read codec/bitDepth/bitrate/encoder/mp3LameTag (ComputeTruedatVerdict); also identity / dedupe / verify.
_added_by_sanity_check_2026_08_10.loudnessMomentary: BASE re-extract canary in HasCurrentFeatures — if excluded, every entry reads as stale and re-analyzes on EVERY scan (infinite re-extract).
_added_by_sanity_check_2026_08_10.spectralContrastCoeffs: --refresh-features / --stats wave marker, paired with dynamicComplexity in HasCurrentFeatures and the advisor.

bpmHistogram.reason: ~29% of the catalog, ~94% zeros, no consumer (write-only; bpm peaks are separate extractor fields). GATE: writer/.mbxs/--fixup .

trackId.reason: iTunes-XML-local numbering; consumed by nothing (hub MoodCache skips it; truedat only round-trips it), churns on every XML re-export, and is meaningless across merged libraries -- at best a trace to the origin file, which merging loses. Suppressed on write, stripped by --fixup.

summarize._note: chordsHistogram is KEEP-RAW (extended), NOT summarized — harmonic similarity (cross-track cosine) needs the raw [24] array. Summarize-in-place (chordsEntropy/chordsConcentration/major-minor mass) is a documented fallback only, if storage pressure ever appears.
